name: Tracker Data 8
definition: Specifies the detailed information as provided by a payment tracking system.

ConfirmedDate.name: Confirmed Date
ConfirmedDate.definition: Point in time when the creditor’s account has been credited with the funds for a payment.

ConfirmedAmount.name: Confirmed Amount
ConfirmedAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively credited to the creditor and confirmed to the tracking system by the agent.

ReturnedConfirmedDate.name: Returned Confirmed Date
ReturnedConfirmedDate.definition: Point in time when the creditor’s account has been credited with the funds for a payment return.

ReturnedConfirmedAmount.name: Returned Confirmed Amount
ReturnedConfirmedAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively credited to the creditor for a payment return and confirmed to the tracking system by the agent.

RemainingToBeConfirmedAmount.name: Remaining To Be Confirmed Amount
RemainingToBeConfirmedAmount.definition: Amount of money remaining to be confirmed.

PreviouslyConfirmedAmount.name: Previously Confirmed Amount
PreviouslyConfirmedAmount.definition: Amount of money previously credited to the creditor and confirmed to the tracking system by the agent.

PreviouslyConfirmedDate.name: Previously Confirmed Date
PreviouslyConfirmedDate.definition: Point in time when the previous amount was confirmed.||Usage: |This date provides the point in time when the last previous confirmed amount was provided to the tracker, in case of a partial confirmation.
